fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Throws a blade that deals 5 damage. It has 50% more critical chance until something has bled.

fusions.name: Gutting Slip
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 16 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Hidden Edge
fusions.desc: Conjures a hidden trap of jaws onto the nearest enemy. It waits 30 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it. Its effect increases by 11% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Cut and Cover
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
